get.description:
Eventually consistent, on the same terms as M:EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Controllers.v1.EnrollmentAdminController.GetEnrollmentContactOverrides(System.String,System.Guid,System.Int32,System.Int32,System.String,System.Threading.CancellationToken).
`EventType` on `GetAllChangesRequest` is a single optional string, so it cannot express "any of these event types" on its own. The filter is built through `Filter` instead - a raw Elasticsearch `query_string` - while `EntityType` and `EntityId` stay the typed fields M:EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Controllers.v1.EnrollmentAdminController.GetEnrollmentContactOverrides(System.String,System.Guid,System.Int32,System.Int32,System.String,System.Threading.CancellationToken) already uses. The change log applies the typed fields as `filter` clauses and `Filter` as a `must` clause on the same bool query, so the two combine as an AND: this call still never leaves this contact's own entity scope.
The event types covered are EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Controllers.v1.ViewModels.Responses.EnrollmentAdmin.ContactOverrideHistoryExtensions.ContactEventTypes, which tracks what the Enrollment outbox publishes against a contact.

The body of a contact update.

The body of a contact-student association update - the association attributes only. Neither the
contact nor the student themselves are editable through this route.

The body of a Program update. The school never changes; the program type and the requirement
set are replaced from the ids given here (an empty list clears the requirements).
The body of a Registration update.

The body of a requirement update: every field is replaced, except EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Controllers.v1.ViewModels.Requests.EnrollmentAdmin.UpdateRequirementRequestDto.IsRequired, which
keeps the stored value when left out. EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Controllers.v1.ViewModels.Requests.EnrollmentAdmin.UpdateRequirementRequestDto.IsUploadEnabled must be sent, because the
service reads a missing value as false. EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Controllers.v1.ViewModels.Requests.EnrollmentAdmin.UpdateRequirementRequestDto.Url is replaced like the title, under the create
rule. Programs keep the copy of a requirement taken when they were last saved; changing a requirement
does not rewrite those copies.

id.description: Must match the id in the route.

tenantId.description: Must match the tenant in the route.

addressStateAbbreviation.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. `TX`. Required when AddressState is sent.

addressState.description: Full name of the state in AddressStateAbbreviation, e.g. `Texas`.

EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Contr.description: The body of a full school replace by id (not keyed on ExternalDataSourceSchoolId).

The body of a student-contact association update - the association attributes only, on the same
full-replacement terms as EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Controllers.v1.ViewModels.Requests.EnrollmentAdmin.UpdateContactStudentRequestDto.

The body of a student update. As EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Controllers.v1.ViewModels.Requests.EnrollmentAdmin.UpsertStudentRequestDto, contact association is
managed exclusively through the `/students/{id}/contacts` sub-resource, not through this call.

tenantId.description: Must match the tenant in the route.

externalDataSourceSchoolId.description:
When present, the upsert is keyed on this id rather than SchoolStateShortCode:
a live school with a matching external id is updated; a soft-deleted one is refused (recover it
first). When absent, a new school is always inserted, and a SchoolStateShortCode
collision on insert is rejected as AlreadyExists.

addressStateAbbreviation.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. `TX`. Required when AddressState is sent.

addressState.description: Full name of the state in AddressStateAbbreviation, e.g. `Texas`.

EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Contr.description: The body of a school creation or update.

The body of a student upsert, keyed by EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Controllers.v1.ViewModels.Requests.EnrollmentAdmin.UpsertStudentRequestDto.StudentLocalCode (the district's SIS code). Contact association is managed
exclusively through the `/students/{id}/contacts` sub-resource, not through this call.
One allowed pathway on a student: the pathway record id.
What a round create/update/delete/recover/purge/duplicate reports back - the identity, not the row.

An application round: a named enrollment period in a school year, identified by
(EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Controllers.v1.ViewModels.Responses.EnrollmentAdmin.ApplicationRoundResponseDto.Code, EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Controllers.v1.ViewModels.Responses.EnrollmentAdmin.ApplicationRoundResponseDto.SchoolYear). EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Controllers.v1.ViewModels.Responses.EnrollmentAdmin.ApplicationRoundResponseDto.State and each window's state are
derived by the service at the moment of the read - NotYetOpen, Open or Closed - and never stored.
What a window add/update/remove reports back.

value.description: The corrected detail. The DELETE route removes an override instead; this is never blank.

expectedVersion.description:
The `lastUpdatedDateTime` the client read, round-tripped back. When it no longer matches the
write is refused with 412 rather than winning because it arrived second. Omit to skip the check.

EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Contr.description: The body of an override write.
What a contact create or update reports back.

detail.description: Which detail this entry is about: `email` or `phone`.

action.description: `set` or `removed`. A removal returns the detail to its SIS value.

previousValue.description: The value this entry superseded, if any. Superseded values are kept, never deleted.

actingStudentId.description: The student whose screen the change was made from, when one was recorded.

eventType.description:
The change log's event type, e.g. EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Controllers.v1.ViewModels.Responses.EnrollmentAdmin.ContactOverrideHistoryExtensions.OverrideEventType
or one of the created/updated/deleted event types. Lets a client distinguish entries in a combined
changelog feed - only override entries carry EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Controllers.v1.ViewModels.Responses.EnrollmentAdmin.ContactOverrideHistoryEntryDto.Detail/EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Controllers.v1.ViewModels.Responses.EnrollmentAdmin.ContactOverrideHistoryEntryDto.Action and the
value fields; the others read null there.

EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Contr.description: One entry in a contact's override history.

lastUpdatedDateTime.description: The new version, for a client that keeps editing without re-reading.

EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Contr.description: What an unlock reports back, so the caller can re-render without a second GET.
What linking or updating a contact-student association reports back. StudentId is the student record id.
What removing a contact-student association reports back.

One student linked to a contact. `_id` is the link entry's own id, NOT the student: read
`studentId` for the student record id and `studentLocalCode` for the SIS code.
What a contact verification reports back.

A window the round owns. Instants are UTC; EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Controllers.v1.ViewModels.Responses.EnrollmentAdmin.EnrollmentWindowDto.TimeZone is the IANA zone they are
shown in. EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Controllers.v1.ViewModels.Responses.EnrollmentAdmin.EnrollmentWindowDto.OpensAt is absent when EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Controllers.v1.ViewModels.Responses.EnrollmentAdmin.EnrollmentWindowDto.DependsOn sets the open moment.
EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Controllers.v1.ViewModels.Responses.EnrollmentAdmin.EnrollmentWindowDto.UnavailableReason is present only while the dependency keeps the window closed.

What a feeder pattern create/update/delete reports back - just the identity, not the row.
Compare ProgramMutationResultDto: a client that needs the saved state re-reads the entry.

One Registration Application referencing this program - see
EnrollmentAdminController.Programs.GetProgramApplications.

What a program create/update/delete reports back - just the identity, not the row. Compare
ContactMutationResultDto: a client that needs the saved state re-reads the program.
The program type, as embedded on the program. EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Controllers.v1.ViewModels.Responses.EnrollmentAdmin.ProgramTypeRefDto.ProgramTypeId is the program-types row.

A district-level program category. Programs embed a copy of it
(EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Controllers.v1.ViewModels.Responses.EnrollmentAdmin.ProgramTypeRefDto: `{ id, programTypeId, programTypeName }`), where
`programTypeId` is this row's EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Controllers.v1.ViewModels.Responses.EnrollmentAdmin.ProgramTypeResponseDto.Id. EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Controllers.v1.ViewModels.Responses.EnrollmentAdmin.ProgramTypeResponseDto.ProgramTypePublicName is the
name families see, when the district sets one.

What a requirement create/update/delete reports back - just the identity, not the row. Compare
ProgramMutationResultDto: a client that needs the saved state re-reads the requirement.

One requirement, as embedded on the program. EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Controllers.v1.ViewModels.Responses.EnrollmentAdmin.RequirementRefDto.RequirementId is the requirements row.
EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Controllers.v1.ViewModels.Responses.EnrollmentAdmin.RequirementRefDto.IsRequired is copied from that row when the program is saved; false means optional.
EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Controllers.v1.ViewModels.Responses.EnrollmentAdmin.RequirementRefDto.Url is copied the same way, and set only on a `url` requirement.

Something a family must satisfy for a program. Programs embed a copy of it
(EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Controllers.v1.ViewModels.Responses.EnrollmentAdmin.RequirementRefDto), where `requirementId` is this row's EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Controllers.v1.ViewModels.Responses.EnrollmentAdmin.RequirementResponseDto.Id.
EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Controllers.v1.ViewModels.Responses.EnrollmentAdmin.RequirementResponseDto.RequirementType is one of `document`, `url`, `information` or
`event`. EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Controllers.v1.ViewModels.Responses.EnrollmentAdmin.RequirementResponseDto.IsUploadEnabled can only be true for a `document` or an `event`.
EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Controllers.v1.ViewModels.Responses.EnrollmentAdmin.RequirementResponseDto.IsRequired false means the requirement is optional. EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Controllers.v1.ViewModels.Responses.EnrollmentAdmin.RequirementResponseDto.Url is the online
form of a `url` requirement, absent for other types.

Created is true only for an upsert that inserted a new school; it drives the
            controller's 201-vs-200 split. An update result always reports false.

The school a program runs at, as embedded on the program. `id` is this entry's own
identity; EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Controllers.v1.ViewModels.Responses.EnrollmentAdmin.SchoolRefDto.SchoolId is the school row it was copied from.
What linking or updating a student-contact association reports back. ContactId is the contact record id.

A contact linked to a student, joined with that contact's own live name/email/phone, plus the
association attributes read from this student's own EnrollmentStudentContact entry for the
contact. The reverse-direction sibling of EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Controllers.v1.ViewModels.Responses.EnrollmentAdmin.ContactStudentDetailDto. `id` is the
contact record id; `externalDataSourceContactId` is its SIS id, when it has one.
What removing a student-contact association reports back.

One contact link on a student. `id` is this entry's own identity; EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Controllers.v1.ViewModels.Responses.EnrollmentAdmin.StudentContactResponseDto.ContactId is the
contact record it links to.
What a student upsert or update reports back - just the identity, mirroring ContactMutationResultDto.

One Enrollment Student, from the list and the get-by-id route alike. `registrationId` is set only on
a list row that stands for a registration not yet linked to a student (a new student): that row's
`id` is the registration's id, which the get-by-id route cannot resolve, so a client must not open a
student profile from it. Absent on every real student.

"Available only while window EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Controllers.v1.ViewModels.Responses.EnrollmentAdmin.WindowDependencyDto.WindowId of round EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Controllers.v1.ViewModels.Responses.EnrollmentAdmin.WindowDependencyDto.RoundId is EdGraph.HttpAggregators.Tenant.Api.Controllers.v1.ViewModels.Responses.EnrollmentAdmin.WindowDependencyDto.WhenState" (Open or Closed).

EnrollmentApi.EnrollmentRegistrations.V1.description:
Pathway (the pathway/screen catalog entity) is unrelated to the Registration/Application
rename and is not touched here - only the message name below stays as-is.

programId.description: enrollment-svc-programs._id - one school's offering of a program.

rank.description:
The family's preference order within the round. 1-based and contiguous across the
registration - the matcher's contract. Assigned server-side, never supplied by a caller.

priority.description: The priority tier - sibling, staff, feeder, PreK. Unset until the priority engine stamps it.

applicationRoundId.description: Foreign key into the application round this entry was submitted to.

EnrollmentApi.EnrollmentRegistrations.V1.description:
One Program-seat choice on a Registration - zero-to-many, independently approvable. See
ApproveRegistrationApplication / GetRegistrationApplications.

progress.description:
Decimal progress (0-100, 2dp) carried as an invariant-culture string,
mirroring the legacy enrollmentresults.proto completedProgress convention.

EnrollmentApi.EnrollmentRegistrations.V1.description:
The student a registration is for. studentId is the EnrollmentStudent record id, all zeros until
the registration is linked; the local/state/external ids and names are denormalized from the
student or supplied by the registration flow. No id of its own.

oauth2.description: Use bearer token generated from an OpenId server
